business_profile.business_summary: A company with 10 to 12 staff handling air conditioner service requests. They currently manually process and track service requests, leading to time consumption, and want to implement an automated web application for request assignment, tracking, and technician performance monitoring.

current_processes.current_state: Service requests (complaints) are manually handled by staff sitting behind a desk, assigned manually to technicians, and tracked by hand.
current_processes.pain_point: Handling and tracking service requests manually takes a lot of time and is a dedicated staff role.
current_processes.evidence: There are 10 to 12 staff to handle the service... There are difficulties in handling and a lot of time is being spent on it.

current_processes.current_state: Service requests are manually assigned to technicians based on physical location and availability, without algorithmic optimization.
current_processes.pain_point: Manual assignment is inefficient and does not automatically account for technician workload, location, or customer feedback.
current_processes.evidence: Who all can assign this?... Manual is not needed, automatic assignment should happen.

current_processes.current_state: Technician performance is tracked through manual feedback, negative reviews, and return rates, which are not integrated into the assignment system.
current_processes.pain_point: Technicians with bad reviews, low feedback, or returns are still assigned, leading to potential service issues.
current_processes.evidence: If any technician says that the customer has any issues or conflicts... Bad reviews... If someone has given a return, then they should not be assigned.

current_processes.current_state: Technicians manually track and report daily activities like service requests attended, closed, charges collected, and new products sold.
current_processes.pain_point: Manual reporting is time-consuming and lacks a consolidated graphical dashboard.
current_processes.evidence: Technicians must have access to a graphical dashboard to view their daily work activities... We need another system in a different way.

current_processes.current_state: Managers are not automatically notified about pending or overdue service requests.
current_processes.pain_point: Lack of automated alerts for pending or overdue requests.
current_processes.evidence: This is basically what is needed... the manager receives emails... Needed.

opportunities.current_cost_driver: Manual handling of service requests by dedicated staff.
opportunities.current_state: Staff manually processes incoming service requests, assigns them to technicians, and tracks their status.
opportunities.automation_opportunity: Implement an automated web application to handle service requests, auto-assign them based on location, workload, and time, and track status automatically.
opportunities.metric: Hours per month saved by staff on manual service request handling and tracking.

analysis_notes: The meeting provides a clear business case for automating service request handling, technician assignment, and reporting, but lacks specific numeric data to calculate actual cost savings.
The project cost of 100,000 is a development/implementation cost, not an operational saving, and should not be used to calculate ROI without additional benefit data.
All opportunities are illustrative scenarios due to missing input values; no guaranteed savings can be calculated from the meeting transcript.
The business is an HVAC service company with 10-12 staff, handling AC service requests manually with significant time consumption.
